note_tweet.text: They are separate by design. Chat Grok is optimized for live, high-depth back-and-forth reasoning. Grok Bot is built around a persistent cloud computer so it can sign into tools, run multi-step jobs for hours, and keep working while you are offline. Merging both fully into one would force trade-offs in either the conversation experience or the always-on agent capability. Bot already uses strong models for its reasoning; the separation is about the runtime and interface, not the intelligence.
